text:
Assistant B is clearly better. It answers the question with plausible reasons Thomas might visit the hospital daily despite being healthy, such as regular check-ups, monitoring, or daily therapy. It is generic and could offer more specific possibilities, like dialysis, chemotherapy, a caregiver or visitor role, or an employment reason, but it is relevant and responsive.

Assistant A repeats the same sentence ten times and offers no reasons at all, so it is unhelpful.

[[B]]
